uncertainty_treatment: The deterministic history uses sampled transport response means. Standard errors remain bound in driving_rates, but Monte Carlo covariance, response uncertainty, tritium half-life uncertainty, assumption uncertainty, and model discrepancy are not propagated to fluence, service event times, or signed net output. Zero/zero no-track tallies are conditional sample observations, not proof of zero true rate or an upper bound. Positive or negative ledger signs and missing service events therefore remain unqualified conditional results.
